verdict.rationale: Sprinto is a SaaS compliance platform, so official SDKs are a fair axis to ask about, but the evidence pack shows no official SDK or client library. The API reference pages (push APIs, framework health/vendor data APIs) are raw APIs rather than SDKs, and no OpenAPI spec was found from which to generate clients. The goSprinto/compliance-skills repo contains agent skills, not an SDK for building against Sprinto.
